description: Registers a person in GPFR after they said yes to the consent sentence from gpfr_info, shown word for word. It sends one confirmation email and the registration stays pending until they click its link. At most 3 emails a day per address.

consent.description: Required. The yes the person gave to the gpfr_info consent sentence.

consent_text_version.description: The consent.version from gpfr_info, exactly as returned.

person_said_yes.description: true only when the person said yes to the sentence shown.

earlier_names.description: Optional earlier full names. Hashed on receipt.

email.description: The person's email address. We send one confirmation email to it.

language.description: Optional. Default en. GPFR is live in 24 languages: en, ar, da, de, es, fa, fr, hi, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-BR, ro, ru, sv, th, tl, tr, zh. bg, uk, vi are answered in English.

name.description: The person's full name, as an employer or fund would hold it. Hashed on receipt.

national_number.description: Optional national number and its issuing country.

periods.description: Where the person worked: country, years, optional employer and fund.

country.description: A country: English or native name, alias or ISO code, for example NL or Netherlands.

employer.description: Employer name as the person knows it. Optional.

fund.description: A GPFR fund key from gpfr_info, optional.

name: gpfr_register
title: GPFR: register a person who said yes
